results.question: Did customer switching definitely happen after M-1152 moved? Did the move prove more profit?
results.reply: The evidence cannot confirm that customer switching happened, as it was not measured, nor does it prove new casino-wide profit. Customer switching is an unmeasured possibility. The strongest alternative explanation is that unmeasured factors drove the change since moves were not randomized. Check pre-move trends and measure property-wide effects next.
